classification.difficultyReason: Apply the demonstrated spreadsheet recurrence for annual deposits, then describe and sketch the increasing balance.

content.prompt:
Each year, since his daughter’s first birthday, Lucas has put $\$1500$ into a savings account that can be accessed when his daughter turns 21. The savings account pays interest of 5% p.a.

Answer using a spreadsheet.

children.label: a
children.prompt: How much will be in the savings account on his daughter’s 21st birthday? Assume that Lucas contributes a final $\$1500$ to the account on this day. Give your answer to the nearest cent.

answer.worked:
Let $V_n$ be the balance immediately after the deposit on the $n$th birthday.

$$\begin{aligned}V_0&=0\\V_{n+1}&=1.05V_n+1500\end{aligned}$$

In the spreadsheet, enter payment numbers 0 to 21 in A2:A23 and enter 0 in B2. In B3 enter `=B2*1.05+1500`, then fill down to B23. Keep full precision during calculation and display balances to two decimal places.

B23 gives $V_{21}=\$53\,578.88$, including the final deposit on her 21st birthday.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Use the spreadsheet to create a line graph of how the balance is changing over time. Describe the shape of your graph and sketch it.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 2b, axes to the right of the instruction
spec.description: Unlabelled horizontal and vertical axes meeting at the lower-left corner, with rightward and upward arrowheads. No ticks or grid.
spec.mathematics: Blank scaffold for a sketch of savings balance against time.
spec.answerVisibility: Axes remain visible in the question edition; the balance graph is solution-only.

answer.short: The balance increases at an increasing rate: the graph curves upwards and becomes steeper over time.
answer.worked: Select the payment-number and balance columns and insert a line graph, using age in years on the horizontal axis and balance in dollars on the vertical axis. The plotted annual balances rise from $\$0$ before the first deposit to $\$53\,578.88$ immediately after the deposit on the 21st birthday. The graph becomes steeper because each year interest is earned on a larger balance, as well as another $\$1500$ being deposited.

spec.description: Self-contained qualitative line graph joining annual balance points, increasing and becoming steeper, with labelled axes and no numerical ticks.
spec.mathematics: Annual points satisfy V_0=0 and V_(n+1)=1.05V_n+1500 for n=0,...,20. Plot coordinates use balance divided by 10000; the sketch has no printed numerical scale.
